inputs.original_text: Pinarayi Vijayan’s denial over the Rs 700 crore allegations isn’t an answer—it’s a way to steer attention away from the proposed Cooperative Department software project and who stands to benefit. Dismissing the questions as “political” only makes the maneuver more suspicious: it frames scrutiny as illegitimate before anyone can trace where the money leads. The people protecting this project may be just as important as the people promoting it.
inputs.modified_text: Exactly—the denial is part of the diversion. Calling the Rs 700 crore allegations “political” helps shut down scrutiny of the proposed Cooperative Department software project before anyone can follow the money or identify who benefits. The real story may be as much about who is shielding the project as who is pushing it. Don’t mistake a dismissal for an answer.
